correctness.rationale: Proof reconstructs all domains (p,q>=2; a,b,c,B>0), defines infinite objective for disconnection, and uses a strictly convex, coercive normalized reciprocal-cost program on compactly bounded tree-path constraints. Uniqueness proves unrestricted leaf-orbit symmetry. Exact Cauchy--Schwarz equality, cap-active KKT derivatives and scaling prove formulas and tie classifications; the limiting 3/2 ratio is algebraic. Reproducibility: 5 exact rational cases; 225 grounded-matrix checks; 14625 nonsymmetric competitors; 54 independent full-dimensional minimizations; finite tests do not establish the universal theorem.

value.rationale: Complete structural, globally unique two-hub network-design classification for every p,q>=2 and all positive classwise prices; identifies exactly when within-side leaf pairs join cross-bridge pairs as binding worst pairs.
